milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near one of the magenta concrete powder blocks (closest at (3, 0, 3)) and face it. Max distance 16 with 60° facing tolerance ensures the player has actually located and is looking at the bright landmark block. Since the block is only ~4 blocks from spawn, the player can likely complete this quickly by turning toward it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the dead bush at (7, 0, 7) and face it. Max distance 16 with 60° facing tolerance ensures the player has located and is looking at the dead bush. The dead bush is a small brown plant on sand, placed adjacent to the sandstone cluster, so finding it naturally leads to the next task.

Uses inventory_has because mining sandstone drops the sandstone item which ends up in the player's inventory. The exposed sandstone cluster at (7-10, 0, 7-10) provides accessible surface blocks that can be mined by hand (no tools required, though slow). Checking for at least 1 sandstone in inventory confirms successful mining.
